parse_translation_unit: parse a C or C++ source file into a TranslationUnit using Index.parse with command line args
get_cursor_diagnostics: get all diagnostics from a TranslationUnit and print severity, location, and spelling for each
walk_ast_preorder: walk the AST of a TranslationUnit cursor in preorder and print each cursor kind and spelling
get_cursor_definition: get the definition cursor for a reference cursor and retrieve its location and display name
get_type_info: get the type of a cursor and print its kind, spelling, size, and alignment
